summary: This tutorial explains how to use Thunderbird on Ubuntu 12.04, focusing on adding a Thunderbird shortcut to the launcher, tagging emails, sorting messages by various criteria, and organizing them into threads. It covers adding a Thunderbird icon to the launcher by searching for it in the Dash, marking emails as important or urgent, using quick filters to view tagged emails, and viewing email threads to follow conversations. The tutorial also demonstrates saving emails to a folder named "Saved Mails" and printing them. Key features include sorting emails alphabetically, reversing order, and tagging emails for easy reference.
